subject: Post-demo recap & next steps — economic buyer / budget owner
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jason Smith <jason.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps — economic buyer / budget owner

Hi Jason —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Demo highlights: model routing for lower cost paths, dedicated capacity options for predictable throughput, and the rollout/canary tooling that should help your team validate quality before full rollout.
- Action items we agreed on: share security docs (SOC2 summary + questionnaire), confirm economic buyer and budget owner, and schedule a 30-min intro with procurement/legal if there’s appetite.

Can you confirm who at Acme owns the final economic decision vs who controls the budget? If you prefer, loop them into a 20–30 min intro so we can cover procurement timeline and any required compliance artifacts.

Proposed slots (PST): Thu 11/26 10:00–10:30, Thu 11/26 15:00–15:30, Fri 11/27 09:00–09:30.

Attaching a short SOC2 summary and a lightweight SOW template for context.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps — economic buyer / budget owner

Hi Marissa —

Nice recap and thanks for the materials. Short answers:

- Economic buyer for this initiative is Lena Ortiz, VP Product (lena.ortiz@acme.com). She’ll sign off on strategic spend.
- Budget owner / finance approver is Mark Johnson (mark.johnson@acme.com) in Finance — he controls the PO and budget allocation.

Procurement will need SOC2 evidence and a completed security questionnaire before legal will engage. I’ve cc’d procurement; I’ll also drop an internal org chart in a follow-up so you can see reporting lines.

We’re interested in the Dedicated option for predictable latency but want to understand pricing bands for committed usage vs burst. Can Lena & Mark join a 20-min intro next week?

—Jason

Subject: Intro: Redwood Inference — quick intro & procurement docs

Hi Lena & Mark —

Per my conversation with Jason, wanted to introduce ourselves and suggest a short intro to align on decision criteria and procurement cadence. Quick context: Redwood Inference provides a unified inference platform (hosted, dedicated, private) focused on predictable latency, throughput, and cost controls — we walked through a short demo last week with Jason.

Suggested agenda (20 mins):
- Confirm success criteria & target latency/cost SLAs
- Procurement timeline & required security artifacts (SOC2, questionnaire, SOW)
- Next steps: pilot scope, timeline, and PO/contract owner

Proposed times (PT): Thu 11/26 10:00–10:20 or Thu 11/26 15:00–15:20. If either works please accept the calendar invite I’ll send.

Attachments for procurement review: Redwood-SOC2-Summary.pdf, Redwood-SOW-ACME-v1.docx, and a quick org chart Jason promised — see inline link when he sends it.

If there are specific compliance docs you need, tell us the preferred format/portal and Dev will coordinate the questionnaire.

Best,
